entries.displayName: Dr. Jené Verchick, PsyD — Los Angeles Psychologist
entries.description: Dr. Jené Verchick is a California-licensed clinical psychologist with more than 26 years of experience. She offers couples therapy and marriage counseling, premarital counseling, individual therapy for adults, teen therapy, Jewish couples therapy, panic-attack therapy, and therapy for startup founders. Areas of focus include anxiety, depression, grief, life transitions, trauma, divorce, addiction, relationship difficulties, and founder-related stress. Sessions are by video for clients across Los Angeles, the Bay Area, and San Diego. The website currently indicates that new clients are being accepted.
